dedupe_keys.name: 国土数値情報 下水道関連施設 sewerage and wastewater series on g spatial information center

description: 国土数値情報(下水道関連施設 [sewerage and wastewater] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 不動産・建設経済局. 下水道関連施設として、処理場施設およびポンプ場施設を整備したものである。 作成年度：平成24年度 原典資料：H22年度版下水道統計（（公社）日本下水道協会）、H23年度版下水道年鑑（水道産業新聞社）. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 47 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 不動産・建設経済局. Its tags are デジタルシティ, 国交DPF, 国土数値情報, 神奈川県. It offers 2 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
